news.title: Price target increased by 7.7% to ₹1,148
news.body: Up from ₹1,066, the current price target is an average from 14 analysts. New target price is 17% below last closing price of ₹1,387. Stock is up 75% over the past year. The company is forecast to post earnings per share of ₹22.49 for next year compared to ₹16.95 last year.

news.title: AVALON: Higher Assumed Margins Will Likely Prove Unsustainable Over Time
news.body: Analysts now place Avalon Technologies' fair value estimate at ₹1,119 per share, compared with the prior ₹1,068.71. This reflects updated assumptions on revenue growth, profit margins and a lower future P/E multiple.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues exceed analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹16.95 (up from ₹9.62 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹16.3b (up 49% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹1.13b (up 78% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 6.9% (up from 5.8% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 3.0%. Earnings per share (EPS) also surpassed analyst estimates by 9.0%. Revenue is forecast to grow 17% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 19% growth forecast for the Electronic industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 32% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 52% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: AVALON: Elevated P/E And Execution Risks Will Likely Limit Future Upside
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their price target for Avalon Technologies to about ₹662 from roughly ₹677, reflecting updated assumptions around slightly higher revenue growth, a modestly lower profit margin, a higher discount rate, and a lower future P/E multiple. Analyst Commentary Bearish analysts are signaling a more cautious stance after trimming the price target for Avalon Technologies to about ₹662, framing the stock as more sensitive to execution risks and valuation assumptions than before.

news.title: AVALON: Elevated P/E And Leaner Margins Will Likely Cap Future Returns
news.body: Analysts have inched their fair value estimate for Avalon Technologies higher, with the indicative price target moving from about ₹650 to roughly ₹677, citing updated assumptions around revenue growth, margins and P/E expectations. Analyst Commentary Bearish analysts are using the latest price target revision to highlight what they see as a tighter risk reward setup for Avalon Technologies, even as the fair value estimate edges higher to about ₹677.

news.title: AVALON: Upcoming Board Review Will Support Confidence In Earnings Outlook
news.body: Narrative Update on Avalon Technologies Analysts now keep their Avalon Technologies fair value target steady at ₹1,328, citing slightly adjusted assumptions around discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and forward P/E that refine, rather than overhaul, their prior view. Analyst Commentary Recent commentary from bullish analysts focuses on how current assumptions for discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and forward P/E align with the steady fair value target of ₹1,328, rather than indicating a need for a major reset.

news.title: AVALON: Earnings Quality And Margin Resilience Will Support Future Upside
news.body: Analysts now place Avalon Technologies' fair value at ₹1,068.71, compared with the earlier ₹1,028.17, reflecting updated assumptions around discount rate, revenue growth, profit margins and future P/E. Analyst Commentary Analysts updating their fair value work on Avalon Technologies are focusing on how the revised assumptions around discount rate, revenue growth, profit margins and future P/E line up with the company’s ability to execute and sustain earnings quality.

news.title: AVALON: Upcoming Board Review Will Reinforce Confidence In Earnings Execution
news.body: Analysts have maintained their fair value estimate for Avalon Technologies at ₹1,328. This latest price target update reflects only minor adjustments to the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E assumptions.

news.title: Consensus EPS estimates increase by 12%
news.body: The consensus outlook for earnings per share (EPS) in fiscal year 2026 has improved. 2026 revenue forecast increased from ₹14.9b to ₹15.6b. EPS estimate increased from ₹13.90 to ₹15.52 per share. Net income forecast to grow 41% next year vs 36% growth forecast for Electronic industry in India. Consensus price target up from ₹1,042 to ₹1,101. Share price rose 2.2% to ₹1,053 over the past week.

news.title: AVALON: Upcoming Board Results Review Will Support Confidence In Executing Growth Plans
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their fair value estimate for Avalon Technologies slightly to $1,328 from $1,330, reflecting updated assumptions for discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E after recent Street research, including the Citi move on Grupo Aval. Analyst Commentary Analysts are using the recent fair value trim for Avalon Technologies as a chance to fine tune their models rather than rethink the core investment case.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 5.7% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk High level of non-cash earnings (23% accrual ratio). Minor Risk Share price has been volatile over the past 3 months (5.7% average weekly change).

news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 29%
news.body: After last week's 29% share price gain to ₹1,023, the stock trades at a forward P/E ratio of 59x. Average forward P/E is 41x in the Electronic industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 44% over the past year. Simply Wall St's valuation model estimates the intrinsic value at ₹682 per share.

news.title: Now 25% overvalued
news.body: Over the last 90 days, the stock has fallen 28% to ₹858. The fair value is estimated to be ₹684, however this is not to be taken as a sell recommendation but rather should be used as a guide only. Revenue has grown by 47% over the last year. Earnings per share has grown by 200%. For the next 3 years, revenue is forecast to grow by 20% per annum. Earnings are also forecast to grow by 28% per annum over the same time period.

news.title: AVALON: Steady Fair Value And Upcoming Board Review Will Support Upside
news.body: Analysts have kept their fair value estimate for Avalon Technologies steady at ₹1,330.00, with only slight tweaks to discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E inputs. This reflects a largely unchanged view on upside despite recent research moves such as Citi's downgrade of Grupo Aval.

news.body: Analysts have kept their fair value estimate for Avalon Technologies steady at ₹650.00, with only slight tweaks to discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E assumptions to reflect updated views on the company’s risk profile and earnings potential.
